subject.title: fix: make Back work within channel setup

question: Should channel setup preserve accepted external-plugin installation metadata when Back returns to the picker, while discarding all wizard-local configuration and post-write-hook state?
rationale: This is an intentional shared setup lifecycle contract, not a mechanical defect: it determines which effects survive navigation across bundled and external channel adapters.

options.title: Accept scoped retention
options.body: Keep accepted install metadata managed across picker returns while retaining the pre-effect rollback boundary for config, account, and hook state.

options.title: Require full rollback
options.body: Discard accepted install metadata as well and require users to repeat installation after returning to the picker.

options.title: Narrow the shared contract
options.body: Keep the Back fix but move any adapter-specific persistence semantics behind a more explicit owner-level contract before merge.

recommendation.title: Accept scoped retention
recommendation.body: Keep accepted install metadata managed across picker returns while retaining the pre-effect rollback boundary for config, account, and hook state.

likelyOwner.reason: The linked and current PRs place this contributor closest to the proposed shared setup contract; final product acceptance still requires a setup-area reviewer.
